body: R86 landed 68a6ed9. FatigueCurve wired into _run_impact (actor drives technique/power/output, target drives defence). The attempt gate and actor pick are SWAPPED - a gate before the actor cannot read the thrower's tank - so every seeded fight moved. Seven draws per built impact still holds and is now asserted by replaying the stream; a rejected attempt costs two. R84 finding 1 closed WITHOUT touching WEAR_SCALE (still 0.6): the head fell 10.5/round on a straight line and a scale factor is linear in rounds, so ImpactModel.corner_recovery is the fix - a flat credit in the minute rest_recovery already spends on his wind. 12x5: 40/40 stopped with zero decisions -> 60.8% stopped with 47 decisions. 3x5 holds at 18.3%. Three-knockdown TKO is now 8 of 400 (was 19) and three pinned TKO seeds were re-found; the seed search is recorded in the test. SUITE total=202 fails=0.
